description: Summarise text or any public web page with AI. POST JSON with either "text" (up to 40,000 characters) or "url", plus optional "length" (short, medium, long), "format" (paragraph or bullets) and "language" for the summary. Returns the summary and source details. Failed or empty summaries are not charged. Price: $0.02 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial).

language.description: Language for the summary, e.g. English or fr. Default: same as the source.

length.description: How long the summary should be.

text.description: Text to summarise (use this or url).

url.description: Public web page to summarise (use this or text).

name: summarise

truncated.description: True if a long page was cut before summarising.

title: Summarise ($0.02)
